about.title: About Me
about.description: Hi! I'm Gregorio Navarrete, a fullstack developer with over 3 years of experience creating modern web applications.
about.journey: My programming journey started as a hobby over 3 years ago. At university I immersed myself in algorithm analysis and dynamic data structure programming in C, C++, and Java. However, I developed an interest in building programs in a more visual environment like the web, learning both frontend and backend.
about.learning: Currently I keep learning and building web projects through courses on platforms like Digital House and Platzi.
about.highlights: Among my achievements I highlight the creation of scalable systems, high-performance APIs, and accessible interfaces.
